name: Texas
intro: Texas listings on Nearsite currently cover the Austin metro. Each business below sets its own service radius, so check the service area section on its page before assuming a suburb is covered.

cities.name: Austin
cities.intro: Austin businesses on Nearsite work across the central city and the suburbs along the I-35 and MoPac corridors. Rooftop solar and remodeling work here often involves HOA review and city permitting, so the pages note who handles that paperwork.

name: Colorado
intro: Colorado listings currently cover Denver and the nearer Front Range suburbs. Altitude, snow load and hail are practical factors here, and several businesses address them directly on their pages.

cities.name: Denver
cities.intro: Denver businesses on Nearsite serve the city and the surrounding Front Range. Hail seasons and snow load shape a lot of the work, from roof-mounted equipment to insurance paperwork.

name: Oregon
intro: Oregon listings currently cover Portland and its immediate suburbs. Much of the housing stock is pre-1940, which affects renovation scope, permitting and timelines.

cities.name: Portland
cities.intro: Portland businesses on Nearsite work across the east and west sides of the river. Older homes are common, so contractors here describe how they handle knob-and-tube wiring, settled floors and historic design review.
